bound_design_source.future_implementation_requirement: A later implementation must cite this exact design spec and be hashed under a new reviewed source revision before any cohort generation.

future_manifest_requirements: source revision and deterministic input record
invalidation_rules: missing or mismatched source/design/manifest SHA256 => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
any TRAIN-validation content or latent overlap => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
any held-out factor level absent marginally from TRAIN => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
fewer than 48 canonical validation units => INCONCLUSIVE
control construction not matched on stated layout/color marginals or not functionally sufficient => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
nondeterministic rerun of a future generator => INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE

latent_schema.canonical_unit: one latent tuple: condition, shape_orientation, control_marker_turn, reference_relation, topology, layout_template, color_role_permutation, instance_index.
latent_schema.color_role_scheme: Deterministic four-distinct-color permutation from colors 1..9: background, shape, marker, output; no fixed color-position shortcut.
latent_schema.seed_scheme: seed = 810000 + 104729*condition_index + 7919*cell_index + instance_index; all random choices must be constructed with local random.Random(seed).

matched_controls.FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL: Same input marginals and output format; output is rotated by fixed +1 turn regardless of marker, testing rotation execution without marker-to-turn binding.
matched_controls.MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL: Same marker/layout/color marginals; output is a canonical 1x4 direction code whose occupied output position is control_marker_turn, testing marker interpretation without shape rotation.
matched_controls.NO_TRANSFORM_RETENTION_CONTROL: Same shape/layout/color marginals; output is the canonical unrotated L_TRIOMINO, detecting a broad failure to retain rendering/copy behavior.
matched_controls.ROTATION_TARGET: Output is the L_TRIOMINO rotated by control_marker_turn; model must use the marker-to-turn binding.

primary_estimand.definition: For a later prospectively matched intervention and control, compute per-unit exact-grid(intervention) - exact-grid(control) on ROTATION_TARGET validation units, macro-average the four reserved structural cells.
primary_estimand.interpretation_limit: No causal effect is established by this prefreeze specification.
primary_estimand.name: matched orientation-target exact-grid difference

prohibitions: No model loading, inference, GPU use, gradient computation, optimizer construction, or training
No Gold, dGold, FINAL_AUDIT, or sealed evaluation data
scope: ONE_FUTURE_ORIENTATION_ONLY_STUDY; CPU-only declarative design, no implementation or output generation.

structural_split.content_and_latent_disjointness: Future generator must emit canonical content SHA256 and latent-signature SHA256, reject any cross-split duplicate, and fail closed before model access.

unit_and_strata.unit: canonical latent task unit; prompt or serialization variants are not additional units
